blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI) has called for more container yards to address the buildup of empty shipping containers at the country’s ports. PCCI vice president for trade facilitation Bryan Ang said the shortage of space for empty containers was an urgent concern, particularly amid the imbalance between inbound and outbound shipments. Ang placed the imbalance at seven inbound containers for every outbound container, underscoring the need for sufficient yard space to accommodate empty containers awaiting return. “We have to find enough container yards for the return of empty containers,” Ang said.
